description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waradala, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510001 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, extent, encumbrances, and property rights. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration processes, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category.
